messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — OptKit delivery status: quantization recommendations landed on staging. Caching/batching shim still unowned and blocking canary. pinging @maria @sanjay for rollout plan.
maria: Saw the PR, thanks. I can own the cache shim integration if we agree on the fallback policy. ETA end of day tomorrow for a first pass.
sanjay: I'll take responsibility for the quantization flags and QA harness. Found a regression when running long ctx on r2 models — intermittent OOM in the KV cache path.
tara: Which branch is the regression on? I just merged a perf refactor into main yesterday.
sanjay: repro steps in case helpful:
```
# run repro
python tooling/run_eval.py --model r2-14b --seq-len 4096 --batch 8 --warmup 50
```
log snippet:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory while allocating kv_cache
  at serving/runtime/kv_cache.cc:143
```
kevin: OOMs only in staging infra or also locally? Could be a kwarg change in the runtime allocation.
maria: I can add a size guard and fallback to prefix caching instead of full KV cache for now. That'll avoid the OOM spike and keep latency SLOs.
alex: Good. Can we make that a config toggle so Dedicated customers can opt in? We should default to prefix fallback for seq > 2k.
sanjay: Agree. I'll add a regression test in the harness to detect OOMs for >2k sequences. Also will open an issue for improved memory accounting.
ops-bot: deploy triggered by @maria (staging-optkit-shim): started rolling update to optkit-staging-1 (3 nodes)
kevin: Once staging is green, who's doing the canary? I'd volunteer to watch metrics and rollback if tail latency spikes.
maria: I'll push the shim change in ~2 hours. Need a quick code review on the guard logic if someone can spare 15m.
tara: I can review at 3pm PST. Will check memory guard and fallback semantics.
alex: Ownership summary:
- Cache shim integration: maria (will push change)
- Quant flags & QA harness: sanjay (adding OOM test)
- Canary monitoring + rollback: kevin
Action items: maria push PR + request tara review; sanjay add regression test; kevin schedule canary watch for tomorrow AM; alex to update roadmap ticket with new milestone dates.
maria: One more note — we should add a perf metric for kv_cache hit/miss to console so Optimize can suggest different batching heuristics.
kevin: Agreed, instrumentation will help Optimize give per-route recommendations. I'll file a follow-up to add the metric.
sanjay: Filed issue #4521: "kv_cache OOM regression + hit/miss metrics". Assigning to eng-runtime and eng-ml.
alex: Thanks all. Ping here when PRs are up and when staging finishes. :thumbsup:
